title: Gated-Content
tagline: The project is focused on developing token-gated video delivery
description: Currently in the ecosystem there are various greay projects like livepeer and huddle 01 but they do not have something like private video storage. So it helps in solving it and through this users can store their stream encrypted and they can set conditions on whom they want to have access to
how_its_made: Currently the SDK is not so mature so there are various bugs and issues, but I am still looking forward to get it fixed so I can have a proper build
